data.description: Marina Luxury Living | Prime Location | Stunning
data.long_description:
Marina Shores, the highly anticipated development by Emaar Properties, features exclusive 1, 2, 3, and 4-bedroom apartments, along with luxurious 5-bedroom penthouses, all set in the prestigious Dubai Marina.

Situated on the last remaining plot in the marina, this high-rise tower offers exceptional opportunities and a prime waterfront location. Residents can enjoy stunning sea views, a palm-lined promenade, and a vibrant lifestyle with easy access to leisure and recreational options, all framed by the iconic Marina skyline.

 Project Highlights •

•  New development featuring premium residences
• Situated right at the heart of Dubai Marina
• Easy and flexible payment plan options
• Near some of the prominent landmarks
• Access to some of the finest amenities
• Part of an exciting waterfront community

Featues and Amenities

• Swimming Pool
• Gymnasium
• Kid’s Play area
• BBQ area
• Landscaped outdoor areas
• Security
• Parking Spaces

As one of the largest and most carefully planned waterfront communities in the world, Dubai Marina is a marvel to behold. Its cosmopolitan, free-spirited vibe and singular character come from the fact that it combines the best of both the city and the water.
